layout.title: My account
layout.pending: Your account is waiting for the board’s approval. You will get an email as soon as the members’ area (events, photos, messages) is open to you.

profile.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 2 MB max. The image is cropped and stripped of its metadata.
profile.emailHint: Your login, only visible to the board.

security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been logged out.
security.dataText: Download a copy of all the data the club holds about you (JSON format).
security.deleteText: This cannot be undone. Your messages stay visible to others under the name “Former member”.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.required: Required for the administrator: turn it on to access the club’s features.
twoFactor.backupIntro: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe: each one only works once.
twoFactor.active: On: a code from your app is asked for at every login.
twoFactor.stepScan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator…).
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to set up two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Protect your account with a temporary code on top of your password.

notificationSettings.pushUnsupported: This browser doesn’t support push notifications. On iPhone, add the site to your home screen first.
notificationSettings.prefsIntro: The site’s notification centre always gets everything.
notificationSettings.caption: Channels enabled per category

membership.thanks: Thank you! Your “{badge}” badge is visible to other members.
membership.howToPay: Pay your membership fee to the treasurer (cash, cheque or bank transfer). You can write to them from the messages, “Treasury” mailbox.
membership.notOpen: This season’s membership fee isn’t open yet.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: You log in with the fingerprint, face or PIN of these devices. A synced passkey (iCloud, Google) follows you to your other devices.
passkeys.empty: Log in with your phone’s fingerprint, face or PIN, without a password.
passkeys.removeText: You will no longer be able to log in with it.
passkeys.removeLast: This is your last passkey: you will have to create a new one to get the board tools back.
passkeys.addHint: An email warns you whenever a passkey is added.

passkeySetup.lead: It protects the members’ data and the treasury. It takes a minute, once.
passkeySetup.typingText: Your fingerprint, your face or your phone’s PIN is enough.
passkeySetup.phishingText: The passkey only opens on {site}: a trap email can’t steal it.
passkeySetup.deviceTitle: Your fingerprint stays on your phone.
passkeySetup.createHint: Your phone then opens its own window: approve it as if unlocking it.
passkeySetup.doneText: Next time you log in, your fingerprint or your face will do.
passkeySetup.doneCodeGone: The 6-digit code is no longer asked for.
passkeySetup.tip: Tip: also add a passkey on your computer, from {link}.
